notes: Every Meshy prompt used for Bush League Baseball, so the generated set can be reproduced. Generate from the admin panel (Bush League tab); clean up with scripts/blender/bushleague/; export to this folder; run pnpm assets. Animation action ids come from Meshy's animation library and are filled in when a clip is chosen.

negative.ballplayer: logos, team names, numbers, text, real players, bats, gloves, ground plane, background
negative.ballpark: people, logos, team names, real ballparks, text, background
